legales.hosting_desc: The platform's infrastructure is hosted on secure servers. The data of our faithful and users are protected in accordance with international security standards.
legales.data_collection_desc: We collect the data strictly necessary for the operation of the service and your spiritual edification: account identifiers, published content, favorites, subscriptions, and reading history.
legales.data_use_desc: Your data is used solely to personalize your experience on the platform. It is neither resold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
legales.rights_desc: In accordance with current data protection regulations, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your information. From your profile, you can manage your information or irreversibly delete your account at any time.
legales.cookie_desc: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device when visiting a website, allowing it to remember your preferences.
legales.cookie_use_desc_1: The platform uses only technical local storage to keep your login session active and secure.
legales.cookie_use_desc_2: No advertising or commercial tracking cookies are placed. Your browsing on our spiritual platform remains completely private and untargeted.
legales.consent_desc: Your consent is collected during your first visit via the informative banner displayed at the bottom of the screen.
legales.purpose_desc: The Church Platform aims to provide a digital space for spiritual edification, sharing the Word, and accessing Christian resources.
legales.behavior_desc: By using this platform, you agree to adopt respectful, benevolent behavior that complies with Christian values. It is forbidden to publish abusive, defamatory content or content that infringes on the rights of third parties.
legales.moderation_desc: The administrators and pastors of the platform reserve the right to hide or delete any content deemed inappropriate, or to suspend an account that does not comply with these terms of use, without notice.
